ipsi_contra_evidence._note: 2026-10-21 補：讀 bioRxiv v2 全文（10.1101/2025.04.23.650240v2.full），PART 1 第 3 節「AOTU019 抑制對側、AOTU025 興奮同側」的實驗根據
ipsi_contra_evidence.transmitter: AOTU025 is cholinergic, whereas AOTU019 is GABAergic. This conclusion is based on machine classification of electron microscopy (EM) images, as well as genetic evidence (Fig. S3B).
ipsi_contra_evidence.gad1_validation: Validation of AOTU019's GABAergic identity, as predicted by automated classifications from Flywire-FAFB and MaleCNS. Confocal image of AOTU019 labeled with the Gad1.AD hemidriver (Gad1.AD;VT033301.DBD) driving GFP.
ipsi_contra_evidence.projection: AOTU025 projects to the ipsilateral copies of steering descending neurons (DNs), whereas AOTU019 targets the contralateral copies of these DNs (Fig. 4A, Fig. S5A).
ipsi_contra_evidence.current_injection_fig4B: Effects of current injection into AOTU019 (+: n = 15; −: n = 8) or AOTU025 (+: n = 15; −: n = 5) during arousal stimulation and walking. Depolarizing either cell type drove ipsilateral turning (p < 0.0001) ... Hyperpolarizing AOTU019 drove contralateral turning (p < 0.05) ... Hyperpolarizing AOTU025 had no significant effects (p = 0.362, p = 0.246).
ipsi_contra_evidence.see_saw: If DNs linearly sum their inputs and steering depends on the right–left difference in DN activity, ipsilateral excitation and contralateral inhibition will have equivalent effects. (see-saw model of steering control, Fig. 4C)
ipsi_contra_evidence.not_measured: 本課讀到的原文裡沒有同時記錄 AOTU019 與 DNa02 的實驗；「AOTU019 放電壓低對側 DNa02」是從接線、傳導物質與打電流後的轉向推得
